progress.summary: Slice 1 freezes four canonical pressure cases, pre-integration performance and payload budgets, the legacy scheduling policy baseline, and falsifiable pass/fail criteria.

expectedLearning: Whether one lineage-constrained glyph matcher and one bounded geometry scheduler cover one-to-one, many-to-one, one-to-many, and crowded responsive notation without operation-specific scheduling.
Whether KP preserves a measurable advantage through static-JS branching, seek/rewind, accessibility, hover, annotations, Cloze, and headless compilation while reducing scheduling policy.
allowedWork: Exactly the approved four-case replacement experiment and its matcher, scheduler, ephemeral plan, JS and headless backends, verification, visual evidence, and deletion budget.
disallowedWork: No operation-specific scheduler, durable glyph IR, second animation format, family rollout, quadratic publication, radical handoff repair, new renderer domain, CAS, live LLM API, or unrelated user changes.
